selection_rule: Pass all four safety/recall guardrails, then maximize mean F1 across full-atlas gold, atlas-held-out, and independent-external evaluations.
rationale: Round 14 is selected because it is the only candidate that reaches the prespecified 0.80 full-atlas gold-recall floor while remaining below all FP guardrails. It also has substantially higher held-out cord-blood recall and higher mean F1 across the three evaluation frames. Round 12 remains the lower-FP fallback.
